method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Platform Workers Act 2024 (Singapore), the Act as enacted (Act 30 of 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/PWA2024.txt. Not a revised edition.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run pwa-cases-coverage.l4; l4 run pwa-cpf-contributions-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED. First module, coverage: s 3 with the First Schedule (platform services), s 4 (platform operator), s 5 (platform worker), s 6 with the Second Schedule (management control and its presumption), s 7 (no contracting out of association rights), ss 16 to 18 (priority in insolvency), s 36 (strike ballot). Added 11 October 2026 for REQ-0267, a second module: CPF contributions on platform earnings under the CPF Act s 8A and Fourth Schedule inserted by s 97 and the Fourth Schedule para 19 (aggregate platform earnings, Group A and B, the Group A phase-in 2025 to 2029, Group B, rounding, the combined ceiling, provisional deduction), read against the CPF Act deposit as amended. Not encoded: Part 2 Divisions 1 and 2, Part 3 otherwise, Parts 4 to 7, the Third Schedule, the Fourth Schedule beyond the CPF contribution rules, and the Fifth to Tenth Schedules.
